description: Raise a change order against a quote or work order and return its CO-YYYY-NNNN number: the reference, the client, a title, the date, and the original contract value in minor units. Free tier: 5 open.

client.description: The client the change is agreed with, as named on the quote or work order

currency.description: ISO code the contract is priced in. Defaults to the shared business profile's currency

date.description: The day the change was raised, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

duplicate_ok.description: Raise it even though an identical change order exists on this reference. Default false

original_value_minor.description: The contract value BEFORE any change order, net of VAT, in whole minor units. Required on the first change order against a reference; inherited by every later one

reference.description: The quote or work order this change order is against, by its id, e.g. Q-2026-0003 or WO-2026-0001

reference_kind.description: What the reference is. Inferred from the id when omitted: WO-... is a work order, anything else a quote

title.description: What the change is, in one line, e.g. Add a second landing page and drop hosting

name: change_order_create
title: Raise a change order
